neighbours.label: Washington State / Puget Sound place names (Puget, Tacoma, Yakima, Seattle), not George Washington or Washington DC
fire: Salmon runs in Puget Sound have declined sharply over the last thirty years.
The container port at Tacoma handles cargo from across the Pacific.
Wine grapes from the Yakima Valley are sold to wineries along the coast.
Commuters on Bainbridge Island take the ferry across Puget Sound each morning.
A new light rail line now links the airport with downtown Tacoma.
Hop farms near Yakima supply many of the craft breweries in the country.
The legislature in Olympia passed a new tax on large employers in Seattle.
Kayakers paddled along the shoreline of Puget Sound at sunrise.
quiet: Salmon runs in the Columbia estuary off Oregon have declined over thirty years.
The container port at Long Beach handles cargo from across the Pacific.
Wine grapes from the Napa Valley are sold to wineries along the coast.
Commuters on Staten Island take the ferry across New York Harbor each morning.
A new light rail line now links the airport with downtown Denver.
The first president, George Washington, retired to his farm in Virginia.
The legislature in Sacramento passed a new tax on large employers in Los Angeles.
Lobbyists flew to Washington to meet congressional staff before the vote.
